accepted_findings: FineWeb2 intentionally excludes English and recommends pairing with FineWeb, so English FineWeb plus French/Spanish FineWeb2 is an official companion design but not one preprocessing pipeline.
The retained English and French 40-row files lack sufficient immutable retrieval provenance and remain probes only.
Formal training is HOLD until revisions, configs, split/dump, shard identities, deterministic sampling and GlobalVoices decontamination are frozen.
